caption: This carousel shows a practical AI workflow to plan and prioritize work. Start by diagnosing gaps, then turn outputs into a lean, actionable sprint plan. Save this for your next planning session. Which part will you test first this week? #AIforBusiness #Productivity #Prioritization #Entrepreneurship

slides.title: Stop chaotic planning with AI
slides.body: Problem: you overcommit, misprioritize, and lose track. Five prompts to diagnose, improve, apply, check, and refine your plan.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose plan gaps
slides.body: Task: audit plan for prioritization; Input: {plan}; Output: top 3 gaps.

slides.title: 2. Improve prioritization
slides.body: Task: rewrite plan to reflect top 5 items; Input: {plan}; Output: ordered list with owners.

slides.title: 3. Apply actionable briefs
slides.body: Task: generate one-page plan for next sprint; Input: {plan}; Output: brief with 3 concrete actions and owners.

slides.title: 4. Check risks
slides.body: Task: list top 3 risks from plan; Input: {plan}; Output: risk bullets with mitigation.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Task: propose a lightweight daily check; Input: {plan}; Output: 5-min daily checklist and cadence.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Use AI prompts to audit your plan and keep a living sprint backlog.
